title: 第六十二回 七日之祸第六十一回 世子奇
slug: 驭音心经第七十回狼心逞乱
lines: 《驭音心经》第六十二回七日之祸
四王府，天书阁。世子奇召来苏奴，明为伴读，暗则密谋。苏奴乃四皇子乳母之子，年长世子奇三岁，善察言观色，见风使舵，目光流慧，人处得宠，故被留王府，伴世子奇读书。
世子奇食指轻抚掌中猕猴，指节发白：“父皇何处挖来此老朽，竟敢妖言陷害我！若非娲指灵猴窃闻，我至死蒙在鼓中！”
苏奴搁起代抄功课，轻笑：“贵人善忘。太子可还记得尚德楼一箭？”
“昔日你暗箭射他，他怎不今日还你？”
世子奇闻言一怔：“吾那日城楼一箭，射的便是此老朽？”
苏奴颔首：“正是。”
“若非如此，圣上何至于罚太子跪抄《诫子训》三篇？”
此事要说，还须从旧太子被废说起。旧太子被废一年后，有大臣进谏，老皇上又动了恻隐之心，欲复其位。恰那日，老皇上召灸世仙人入宫，欲寻个两全之法，既成全仙人救世之言，又不负自己天伦人情。
偏巧，恰那日，世子奇偷出王府，尚德楼听戏。见一人头戴斗笠，侧身骑驴，腰悬壶酒，悠然徐行，惹得楼上众人侧目。便取弹弓射之，欲惊其驴，催驴快跑，戏耍之。
岂料这一射，未中骑驴，却中其壶。壶破酒泻，香溢一里。外人不知，这壶中所盛之物却乃灸世仙人特酿药酒，专为老皇上治疗心疾所用，名曰“苏合香酒”，极难调制。
老皇上问及此事，灸世仙人忿忿不已：“四皇子世子，伤人为乐，幼不体恤，国断不可有此君！”老皇上笑颜抚慰：“幼子顽劣，确实可恨。然此当为后君所虑，朕所虑者，当今太子也。”
想起此事，世子奇扼腕叹息：“可惜了我那金丝弹弓！”
苏奴拍臀苦笑：“太子惜弓，奴才惜臀。望太子莫忘小人之屁所受责罚！”
世子奇闻言放声大笑，忽又敛容：“你为吾挺身受罚，吾自是铭记。然眼下势险，需你为我谋划一番！”
“日后，吾真为太子，你何愁富贵？”
忽然，娲指灵猴惊跃而起，窜上窗前书柜。世子奇竖指噤声，二人倏然旋身落座，捧书作读状。
片刻，大丫鬟夏兰碎步而来，躬身道：“王爷，娘娘唤你。”
“所为何事？”世子奇问。
“今日大行皇帝头七，娘娘唤王爷同去，祭礼。”
却说容月与法印，策马驰骋，奔至神望坡，已是暮色四合，月出林梢。众人饥肠辘辘，人困马乏，欲寻店歇息。容月不应：“三日之限，转瞬即逝，未寻得慕府老君，岂能歇息？”法印追问：“那该往何处寻觅？”
这一问，倒教容月语塞。她紧攥腰牌，四顾茫然。法印命人买来酒食，劝其进食。容月摇头哽咽：“食不下咽，我怕空手难回！”
这一哭，顿令众人手足无措。倒是验毒的小太监机灵，进言道：“娘娘，那老君既是冥界仙人，需鬼魂通禀，那我们何不捉鬼一问，如此便知？”容月初闻一喜，旋即蹙眉：“我等凡夫俗子，非仙非神，如何捉得了那鬼？”
未料小太监嘻嘻一笑：“寻鬼容易，杀一人不就可成？”
月明星稀，四下荒寂。此言一出，如阴风过境，众人皆觉毛骨悚然。容月又惊又喜，转眼看向法印。法印杀人不眨眼，但听闻此计，亦不禁心头一颤。
临行前，四皇子叮嘱言犹在耳：“容月即朕，朕即容月。你须不惜一切代价，保她周全，速去速回。若有差池，朕唯你是问！”
念及至此，法印冲那小太监微微颔首，意味深长道：“圣上真乃明君！”
“既命你验毒，当物尽其用。”
“这些酒食你尽数用了，饱餐一顿，不枉神望坡一巡！”
小太监闻言色变，手一颤，玉杯坠地，粉碎。
再说老皇帝头七，四皇子与十三弟并辔回宫。四皇子忽轻笑摇首，十三皇子侧马相问：“圣心有碍？”四皇子淡笑：“那邓留方也妄称仙医！”
十三皇子问：“如何见得？”四皇子道：“方才他拦阻朕，言今日有祸，要朕回避。”十三皇子闻听惊问：“今日有祸？何出此言？”四皇子微笑：“朕亦是奇怪。问他时，其取出镜，言其潜象劫元八卦镜，镜像暗红，主凶。朕问其何以累及朕，他言艮位出七，乾爻缺角，卦在天位，故是七日之祸，避之则安，出之有虞。”
十三皇子闻言谏：“既如此，圣上当纳其言，闭门不出。”四皇子闻言长笑：“哈哈哈，岂有天子避祸不出哉？”

"Heart Sutra of Yuyin" Chapter 62: Disaster in Seven Days
The Fourth Prince's Mansion, Tianshu Pavilion. Shi Ziqi summoned Sunu to read with him, but to conspire secretly. Su Nu is the son of the wet nurse of the fourth prince. He is three years older than Prince Qi. He is good at observing people's words and colors, and can steer the ship according to the wind. His eyes are bright and he is favored by others. Therefore, he is kept in the palace to study with Prince Qi.
The prince's index finger caressed the macaque in his palm, and his knuckles turned white: "Where did my father find this old man? How dare you tell me such lies! If it weren't for the magic monkey Wa Zhizhi who overheard it, I would have been kept in the dark until my death!"
Su Nu put aside the homework he had copied and chuckled: "Noble people are forgetful. Does the prince still remember the arrow from Shangde Tower?"
"You shot him in the dark in the past, why doesn't he pay you back today?"
Shi Ziqi was startled when he heard this: "I shot an arrow from the city tower that day, was this old man the one he shot?"
Su Nu nodded: "Exactly."
"If this were not the case, why did the Holy One punish the prince to kneel down and copy three chapters of the "Commandment to the Son"?"
To talk about this matter, we must start with the dethroning of the old prince. A year after the old prince was deposed, some ministers came to remonstrate with him, and the old emperor felt compassion for him again and wanted to resume his throne. On that day, the old emperor summoned the Immortal Moxibustion into the palace, hoping to find a way to achieve both goals, which would fulfill the Immortal's words of saving the world and live up to his own family relationships.
Coincidentally, on that day, Shi Ziqi sneaked out of the palace to attend a play in Shangde Tower. I saw a man wearing a bamboo hat, riding a donkey sideways, with a pot of wine hanging on his waist, walking leisurely, which attracted the attention of everyone upstairs. Then he took his slingshot and shot at it. In order to scare the donkey, he urged the donkey to run fast and played with it.
Unexpectedly, this shot missed the donkey but hit the pot. When the pot is broken, the wine is purged, and the fragrance overflows for a mile. Unknown to outsiders, the content in this pot is a medicinal wine specially brewed by the Moxibustion Immortal. It is specially used by the old emperor to treat heart diseases. It is called "Storax wine" and is extremely difficult to prepare.
When the old emperor asked about this, the Moxibustion World Immortal was very angry: "The fourth prince, the crown prince, enjoys hurting others, and is incompetent at a young age. The country must not have such a king!" The old emperor smiled and comforted: "The young son is stubborn and naughty, and it is indeed hateful. However, this should be considered by the queen, and the one I am worried about is the current prince."
Thinking of this, Shi Ziqi sighed: "What a pity for my golden slingshot!"
Su Nu slapped her butt and smiled bitterly: "The prince cherishes his bow, and the servant cherishes his buttocks. I hope the prince will not forget the punishment for the villain's fart!"
Shi Ziqi laughed loudly when he heard this, and then suddenly calmed down: "You stood up for me and suffered punishment, I will remember it. However, the situation is dangerous now, and I need you to make a plan for me!"
"In the future, if I am truly the prince, why should you worry about wealth?"
Suddenly, Wa's fingered monkey jumped up in surprise and ran up to the bookcase in front of the window. Shi Ziqi raised his finger and said nothing, and the two of them suddenly turned around and sat down, holding books and reading.
After a moment, the eldest maid Xia Lan came over in small steps, bowed and said: "Your Majesty, the queen is calling you."
"What's the matter?" Shi Ziqi asked.
"Today is the seventh day of the emperor's grand ceremony. The queen calls the prince to go with her to perform sacrifices."
But Rong Yue and Fa Yin galloped to Shenwang Slope. It was dusk and the moon was rising above the forest. Everyone was hungry, sleepy and exhausted, and wanted to find a place to rest. Rong Yueying said: "The limit of three days is fleeting. How can we rest until we find Mr. Mu Mansion?" Fayin asked: "Then where should we look for him?"
This question made Rong Yue speechless. She clutched her belt tightly and looked around in confusion. Dharma Seal ordered people to buy food and wine and persuaded him to eat. Rong Yue shook her head and choked up: "I can't eat, I'm afraid I won't be able to return empty-handed!"
This cry immediately made everyone at a loss. However, the little eunuch who tested the poison was smart and said: "My dear, since the old gentleman is an immortal in the underworld and needs to be informed by ghosts, why don't we catch the ghost and ask him, so that we can find out?" Rong Yue heard this and immediately frowned: "We ordinary people, neither immortals nor gods, how can we catch that ghost?"
Unexpectedly, the little eunuch chuckled: "It's easy to find ghosts, but can you just kill one person?"
The moon and stars are sparse, and everything is deserted. As soon as these words came out, like a dark wind passing by, everyone felt their hair stand on end. Rong Yue was surprised and happy, and turned to look at the seal. Fayin kills people without blinking an eye, but when he heard this plan, he couldn't help but feel a tremor in his heart.
Before leaving, the fourth prince's words still rang in his ears: "Rong Yue is me, and I am Rong Yue. You must protect her at all costs, and go back quickly. If anything goes wrong, you are the only one I will ask!"
Thinking of this, Fayin nodded slightly to the little eunuch and said meaningfully: "Your Majesty is truly a wise king!"
"Since I ordered you to test the poison, make the best use of it."
"You have used up all the food and wine. You will have a full meal and your visit to Shenwangpo will be worth it!"
The little eunuch's expression changed when he heard this, his hand trembled, and the jade cup fell to the ground and shattered.
Let's talk about the old emperor's first seven years. The fourth prince and his thirteenth brother returned to the palace together. The fourth prince suddenly chuckled and shook his head, and the thirteenth prince asked sideways: "Is the Sacred Heart in trouble?" The fourth prince smiled lightly: "Then Deng Liufang also falsely claims to be an immortal doctor!"
The Thirteenth Prince asked: "How do you know that?" The Fourth Prince said: "Just now he stopped me and said that there will be misfortune today and asked me to avoid it." The Thirteenth Prince was surprised when he heard this and asked: "There is misfortune today? Why did you say this?" The Fourth Prince smiled: "I am also surprised. When I asked him, he took out the mirror and said that the latent image of the Tribulation Yuan Bagua Mirror was dark red, and it was the main evil. I asked him why it affected me, and he said that the root position was seven, the stem line was missing, and the hexagram was in the heaven position, so it was a disaster for seven days. If you avoid it, you will be safe. "
The Thirteenth Prince heard the words and remonstrated: "In that case, the Holy One should accept his words and stay behind closed doors." The Fourth Prince laughed when he heard the words: "Hahaha, how can an emperor avoid disaster and not escape?"
